x: The Kelkar Committee (2015) proposed IPAT, the Infrastructure PPP Adjudication Tribunal headed by a former SC/HC judge, and IPRC, the Infrastructure PPP Project Review Committee, to speed up dispute resolution and project review. The ETFs are disinvestment instruments, DIPAM/DPE are departments, and NMP/VGF are monetisation and funding schemes.

The lateral-entry debate weighs domain expertise and fresh ideas against concerns that single posts carry no reservation, possible conflict of interest and demotivation of career officers. Option B inverts the reservation concern: the criticism is the absence of reservation in single-post recruitment, not any automatic enhancement of it.
Nine PSUs were given Navratna status and greater autonomy in 1997 (NCERT-based notes give 1996). 1991 is the year of the reforms, not of the Navratna scheme.

DIPAM began as the Department of Disinvestment in 1999 (APP says 2000), later became a Ministry, and was renamed DIPAM in 2016. 1999 is its origin, not the renaming; 2012 is when OFS came into wide use.
